Stocks whose tail-session volume sits in a stable normalized location on the price path face lower short-horizon adverse-selection risk; unstable volume-location states look more like impact, chase, distribution, or unstable liquidity demand. constraint-driven close-adjacent execution flow, benchmark/passive rebalancing pressure, and unstable liquidity demand liquidity providers or alpha stacks that buy stable execution-state names over 3-5 trading days price-path occupation measure and the 20-day stability of normalized VWAP-minus-TWAP location 3-day and 5-day forward top-decile excess net return plus residual RankIC in non-microcap/index universes $$
\operatorname{Cov}(P,V)= ar V\,(VWAP-TWAP),\qquad \operatorname{Corr}(P,V)= rac{ ar V\,(VWAP-TWAP)}{\sigma_P\sigma_V}.
$$ $$
\mu^V_{i,d,w}(dp)=\sum_{m\in w} V_{i,d,m}\,\delta_{P_{i,d,m}}(dp),\qquad \mu^T_{i,d,w}(dp)=\sum_{m\in w}\delta_{P_{i,d,m}}(dp).

location\_sigma_{i,d,w}= rac{VWAP_{i,d,w}-TWAP_{i,d,w}}{\operatorname{std}(P_{i,d,w})},\qquad S_{i,t,w}=-\operatorname{Std}_{20d} ig(location\_sigma_{i,d,w} ig).
$$ The covariance identity shows that CPV is not merely an invalid price-level correlation. The structure forces a price-axis occupation/location object: VWAP-minus-TWAP is the first moment shift of volume mass relative to time mass on the same price path. The useful signal was not the raw level or raw rho, but the stability of this occupation-location coordinate. The normalized location coordinate preserves where traded mass sits on the intraday price path while removing pure price-level scale. The 20-day dispersion transform removes noisy one-day location levels and captures repeatability of the execution state. Transforming into return increments or adding rho linearly was cleaner-looking but removed or distorted the payer and hurt long-side payoff. Linear rho additions, close_minus_vwap absorption confirmation, and microcap branches were tested and rejected or bounded; extra gates should only be reintroduced as model-stack features with explicit incremental evidence.

Retrieve this method when a research idea, formula, report, or code fragment must be converted into a mathematically identified measurement program. Use knowledge before and during model selection to broaden candidate mathematical objects, recover reusable data treatments, and expose counterexamples; freeze auditable provenance and never let historical IC select the model. Record the selected mechanism, rejected alternatives, observation map, legal information time, expected metric signatures, and falsifiers for every formula or code component. Apply unit or stochastic audits only when the selected mechanism makes them relevant.
economic hypothesis -> open mathematical tool search -> competing model selection -> mechanism-specific derivation -> market-outcome and observation mapping -> measurement program -> data/operator/code implementation -> empirical falsification Prior factor cases, data and operator cards may propose candidate mathematical objects, reusable transformations, counterexamples and failure conditions, but may not select the model by historical performance, redefine the estimand, or reverse contradictory evidence. Stochastic-process projection and dimensional analysis are optional tools or audits, not universal core mechanisms. A fundamental factor may select DCF or residual-income logic; a microstructure factor may select a point process; a path-shape factor may select functional or signal methods. An audit is recorded only when selected; unselected audits do not require decorative not-applicable derivations. Operator, direct code and hybrid routes are coequal when they implement the same approved estimand and observation equation. A failed implementation may be repaired without changing the estimand; a failed mechanism or identification assumption requires a separately identified model branch.
title: Mechanism-conditioned measurement and implementation search

The value-occupation repair state is a short-horizon inventory and liquidity imbalance proxy.
